“‘一步一人头’已经接近神了。”
“二十吧。”
正在上路带线的潘森，听到系统提示的声音，深深的无力感充斥全身。
看着对面已经八层杀人剑的瑞雯，默默的打字道。
却没想到，这一下却是捅了火药桶一般。
“潘森，你个煞笔，前期送成这样，现在就叫二十。英雄联盟就是因为有你这种人存在，才会那么乌烟瘴气的。”
“呵呵，潘森你在游戏里那么逗比，你爷爷奶奶父母姐弟亲兄妹知道吗？”
“一口气送三个人头，你简直吊得飞起。”
“潘森，你好好带线，别说话了。”
最后就连性格最为和善，沉稳的豹女都忍不住让潘森不要说话了。
听到阵阵冷嘲热讽，潘森却是怒火攻心，无视豹女的话，怒道。
“我说错了吗，我打不过没什么好说的，坑了就是坑了。但是你们呢，盲僧跑去对面野区送一个。”
“下路呢，就更牛了，直接塔下强杀不成，反被草。”
“琴女就更煞笔了，可以跑掉，还闪现再送一个。”
“你们也知道对面瑞雯出的杀人剑，结果还不是让对方照样叠得飞起？”
一口气说完，潘森将心中的所有怨气，狠狠出了出来。

这一口恶气，潘森觉得异常舒畅。
“要不是你在上路一口气送三个人头，会有么难？也不知道你是怎么对线的，竟然压不住瑞雯，简直搞笑。”
“还有琴女他也是为了保护我，只不过是我害了他而已，你喷他做什么。”
伊泽瑞尔见潘森无缘无故扯上保护自己的琴女，心中一阵气愤。
要知道如果不是上路爆了的话，瑞雯也不会出现在下路。
自己就能收下女警的人头了，何至于会被他死血跑掉，还赚了两个助攻。
这个潘森简直就是一个逗比。
“我早就说了瑞雯很厉害，叫打野来，他不来，我被爆了有办法？”潘森一脸不屑，有些旧事重提道。
“潘森你简直不可理喻，你不会是对面瑞雯派来的演员吧。我看你也不用推线了，直接挂机去吧。”盲僧一听就怒了，对于这个潘森，他是很瞧不上眼的。
被瑞雯打爆不说，语气还是极差，现在又想二十投，简直就是搅屎棍一样的存在。
“呵呵，正合我意。”潘森听后，怒极而笑，小兵也不补了，直接原地回城。
豹女看到后，眉头紧皱。
“潘森你真的要挂机？只不过前期被打爆了而已，后期对面没有肉，没有突进，完全打不过我们的。”
“你觉得对面瑞雯这操作意识，会让我们拖到后期吗？对面瑞雯不是突进，你逗我呢？”潘森不屑的说道，语气极为蛮横。
“对面伤害全在瑞雯身上，你说瑞雯敢突进来吗？他要是敢过来，琴女直接开大控住，我们集火秒了他。”
“对方要是敢集合推塔，你一个大跳进去，先手控住瑞雯，然后琴女跟上，我们完全可以团灭他们的。”
豹女非常理想化的分析了一下之后的团战，想把潘森劝回来。
但是潘森仿佛对豹女的话视若无睹，直接回了泉水，随后为了表示挂机的决心，直接把身上的装备卖了。
当然说是装备，其实也就两把长剑而已。
由此可见潘森被苏环给压成什么样子了，估计这把过后，潘森可能会对瑞雯有阴影了。

“蠢货。”豹女心中暗骂一声，但是心里却是无奈，没有办法，别人想挂机，他也管不了。
本来就有些艰难的局势，现在少了一个潘森，恐怕局势就要更加困难了。
而且极有可能这把要输，看着对面八层杀人剑，一把残暴之力在手，而且对方出来后又杀了三人，现在身上肯定又聚集了大量的金币。
这样一想，豹女真的觉得瑞雯已经有无敌的趋势了。
现在紫色方又跟潘森闹了内讧，心情估计都是非常压抑不舒服。
打起来肯定没有刚一开始的轻松状态。
想到这些，豹女就头疼，要知道他这把是晋级赛，不然他也不会那么坚持劝说潘森别挂机。
而且语气态度也是很好，这也是建立在这把是他晋级赛的情况下。
要是按照以往他那爆脾气，估计是第一个骂潘森的人，哪还轮到队友来说。
随后豹女为了缓解心中压力，在所有人屏幕上打字道。
“瑞雯大神，求手下留情啊，不要那么凶啊。”
苏环看到后，淡淡一笑，随后在屏幕上打字道。
“不好意思，我用脚玩的，不能手下留情，对不起了。”
后方，王清雅看见，不由捂着嘴，她被逗笑了。
“清雅姐，这个人好逗啊。”
而有些呆萌的李青青则是笑得有些欢乐，丝毫不在意别人的目光，捂着肚子指着苏环说道。
“青青，别笑得那么大声，大家都看着我们呢。”
看着周围的人都把目光都聚集过来，王清雅红着脸小声说道。
“看就看嘛，我才不管。”青青撇了撇嘴说道，不过还是停下了笑声，只不过眼睛却是如月牙儿一般弯着，表示其心情还是很开心。
而苏环听到身后的笑声，也是好奇的转过身去。

一转身，便看到两位美女。
一位娃娃脸，婴儿肥，脸上白净无暇，非常的可爱，此刻眼睛弯着，清澈清纯的眼中有笑意流露，想来心情很是开心。
而旁边亦是一位非常秀美的漂亮美女，脸呈瓜子型，肌肤似雪，有些羞红，一双明净的眼中也是透露着微微笑意，一身白衣更显得有些飘逸，气质文静。
见苏环转过头来，王清雅则有些不好意思的对其笑了笑。
“不好意思，打扰到你了。”
“没事。”苏环淡淡一笑，说完便转过身去。
对于美女，苏环一直都是抱着欣赏的态度，毕竟美女养眼。
当然要他去泡的话，苏环便会觉得很麻烦。
是的，他觉得，女人是一种非常麻烦的生物，交往的话。
要陪着逛街，要哄，要时常联系通话，到最后可能来一句‘我们不合适，分手吧。’
直接就把之前所付出的一切全给否定了。
这得浪费多少感情和时间。
所以苏环是坚决不交女友的，反正他是孤儿，不用为传宗接代而担心。
当然，每次有人问他有没有女朋友的时候。
苏环都会答：“有啊，还是两个。”
嗯，左手和右手，咱们永不分离。
但是，命运是神奇的，苏环是逃不掉的。

"'One step at a time' is already close to God."
"Twenty, maybe."
Pan Sen, who was on the road leading the line, heard the system prompts and felt a deep sense of powerlessness filling his body.
Looking at Ruiwen who was facing the eighth level murder sword across from her, she typed silently.
Unexpectedly, this time it was like a powder keg.
"Pan Sen, you are a bastard. You were sent like this in the early stage, and now you are called twenty. The League of Legends is so chaotic because of the existence of people like you."
"Haha, Pan Sen, you are so funny in the game. Do your grandparents, parents, brothers and sisters know about it?"
"You'll be able to kill three people in one go."
"Pan Sen, take the lead and stop talking."
In the end, even Leopard Girl, who had the kindest and calmest personality, couldn't help but tell Pan Sen to stop talking.
Hearing the cynicism, Pan Sen was filled with rage, ignored Leopard Girl's words and said angrily.
"Am I wrong? I can't beat him, so there's nothing to say. If you're cheated, you're cheated. But what about you, the blind monk ran to the opposite jungle to send one away."
"The bottom lane is even better. You can't kill it directly under the tower, but you will be killed instead."
"Qin Nu is even more outrageous. She can run away and then flash back to give another one."
"You also know that the murderous sword that Riwen shot out from the other side still made the other party fly up in the same way?"
After speaking in one breath, Pan Sen vented all the resentment in his heart.
Pan Sen felt extremely comfortable with this bad breath.
"How difficult would it have been if you hadn't killed three people in one go on the top lane? I don't know how you managed to line up, but you couldn't suppress Riven. It's so funny."
"And Qin Nu is also trying to protect me. It's just that I hurt him. Why are you scolding him?"
Ezreal felt angry when he saw Panson dragging the piano girl who was protecting him for no reason.
You must know that if the top lane had not exploded, Riven would not have appeared in the bottom lane.
He was able to take the policewoman's head, so why did he run away with his lifeless blood, and he also earned two assists.
This Pan Sen is simply a joke.
"I've told you that Riven is very powerful, so I asked the jungler to come. If he doesn't come, what can I do if I get blown up?" Pan Sen asked with a look of disdain, and brought up some old things again.
"Pan Sen, you are simply unreasonable. You can't be an actor sent by the other side, Riven. I think you don't need to push the line anymore, just hang up." The blind monk became angry when he heard this. He looked down upon this Pan Sen.
Not to mention being beaten up by Raven, his tone was still very bad, and now he wanted to make twenty shots, he was just like a troublemaker.
"Haha, it's just what I wanted." Pan Sen laughed angrily after hearing this. He stopped sending troops and returned to the city.
Leopard Girl frowned when she saw it.
"Pan Sen, do you really want to hang up? It's just that you were beaten in the early stage. In the later stage, the opponent has no meat and no breakthrough, so it can't beat us at all."
"Do you think the operational awareness of the opponent's Riven will delay us to the later stage? The opponent's Riven is not making a sudden advance, are you kidding me?" Pan Sen said disdainfully, his tone was extremely arrogant.
"The damage from the other side is all on Ruiwen. Do you think Ruiwen dares to rush in? If he dares to come over, Qin Nu will just use the maximum to control him. We will focus on him and kill him in seconds."
"If the opponent dares to gather together to push the tower, you jump in, control Ruiwen first, and then Qinnu follows up. We can completely destroy them together."
Leopard Girl ideally analyzed the subsequent team battle and wanted to persuade Pan Sen to come back.
But Pan Sen seemed to turn a blind eye to Leopard Girl's words and returned directly to the spring. Then, in order to show his determination to hang up, he directly sold his equipment.
Of course, it's called equipment, but it's actually just two long swords.
This shows how Pan Sen was suppressed by Su Huan. It is estimated that after this, Pan Sen mayThere will be a shadow on Ruiwen.
"Idiot." Leopard Girl cursed secretly in her heart, but she was helpless in her heart. There was no other way. He couldn't control others who wanted to hang up.
It was already a difficult situation, but now that Pan Sen is missing, the situation may become even more difficult.
And it is very likely that this one will lose. Looking at the eight-layer murder sword on the opposite side, a brutal force is in hand, and the opponent has killed three more people after coming out, and now he must have gathered a lot of gold coins.
Thinking about it this way, Leopard Girl really felt that Ruiwen had become invincible.
Now that Zi Fang is having internal strife with Pan Sen again, he is probably feeling very depressed and uncomfortable.
The fight was definitely not as relaxing as it was at the beginning.
Thinking of this, Leopard Girl had a headache. You must know that this is a promotion match, otherwise he would not be so persistent in persuading Pan Sen not to hang up.
And his tone and attitude are also very good, which is also based on the fact that this is his promotion match.
If he had gone by his explosive temper in the past, he would probably be the first one to scold Pan Sen, and it wouldn't be his teammates' turn to do so.
Then Leopard Girl typed on everyone's screen in order to relieve the pressure in her heart.
"Master Ruiwen, please be merciful and don't be so cruel."
After Su Huan saw it, he smiled lightly and then typed on the screen.
"Sorry, I played with my feet. I can't be merciful. I'm sorry."
From behind, Wang Qingya saw it and couldn't help covering her mouth. She was amused.
"Sister Qingya, this person is so funny."
Li Qingqing, who was a bit cute, smiled happily and didn't care about other people's eyes. She held her stomach and pointed at Su Huan.
"Qingqing, don't laugh so loudly, everyone is looking at us."
Seeing that everyone around her was paying attention, Wang Qingya blushed and whispered.
"Just watch, I don't care." Qingqing curled her lips and said, but still stopped laughing, but her eyes were curved like crescent moons, indicating that she was still in a happy mood.
When Su Huan heard the laughter behind him, he turned around curiously.
When he turned around, he saw two beauties.
A girl with a baby face, baby fat, and a flawless face, very cute. At this moment, her eyes are bent, and there is a smile in her clear and pure eyes. I think she is very happy.
Next to her was a very beautiful beauty, with a melon-shaped face, skin like snow, a little blushing, a pair of clear eyes with a slight smile, and a white dress that made her look somewhat elegant, with a quiet temperament.
Seeing Su Huan turn around, Wang Qingya smiled sheepishly.
"Sorry to bother you."
"It's okay." Su Huan smiled faintly, then turned around.
Su Huan has always had an appreciative attitude towards beauties, after all, beauties are eye-catching.
Of course, Su Huan would find it very troublesome if he was asked to take a dip.
Yes, he feels that women are very troublesome creatures when it comes to dating.
You have to go shopping with me, coax you, and keep in touch and call each other. In the end, you may say, ‘We are not suitable, let’s break up. ’
He directly negated everything he had done before.
How much emotion and time is wasted.
Therefore, Su Huan was determined not to have a girlfriend. He was an orphan anyway, so he didn't have to worry about continuing the family line.
Of course, every time someone asked him if he had a girlfriend.
Su Huan would answer: "Yes, there are still two."
Well, left hand and right hand, we will never be separated.
However, fate is magical and Su Huan cannot escape.
